T: Twenty-five lifers, one cottage pie. Nobody gets seconds.
D: Ripley crash-lands on a remote prison planet, and something has come down with her.
P: Serve the snacks when Ripley first walks into the mess hall and every prisoner stops eating.
S: pulled from the wreck on the beach, still in one piece

Boil 4 eggs for 7 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Mix 400g pork sausage mince with 1 tbsp chopped sage, 2 tsp hot English mustard and pepper, divide into 4 and wrap around each egg. Roll in 50g flour, 1 beaten egg and 80g panko. Deep fry in oil at 170C for 6 to 7 minutes until deep golden and cooked through, drain, salt and halve.
Dillon's brothers waste nothing, not even yesterday's spuds

Boil 700g peeled floury potatoes until tender, drain and mash roughly. Fry 1 sliced onion and 250g shredded savoy cabbage in 20g butter until soft and catching. Mix into the potato, season and shape into 8 flat cakes, dust with 2 tbsp flour and chill for 20 minutes. Fry in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 4 minutes a side until crusted. Serve with 4 tbsp brown sauce.
M: ladled out in the mess hall for twenty-five lifers

Brown 700g beef mince in 1 tbsp oil, add a diced onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 2 garlic cloves and soften. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp flour, add 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tsp dried thyme and simmer for 30 minutes. Mash 1.2kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Stir 150g peas into the mince, top with the mash and 80g grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: stale rations from the last supply run, made good

Butter 8 slices of day-old white bread with 50g butter, cut into triangles and layer in a buttered dish with 60g sultanas. Whisk 3 eggs, 300ml milk, 200ml cream, 70g caster sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, pour over and soak for 20 minutes. Grate over nutmeg, sprinkle with 1 tbsp demerara sugar and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set. Rest 10 minutes.
K: poured straight from the furnace, handle with care

Whisk 1 litre full cream milk with 2 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar, half a tsp cinnamon and a pinch of chilli until steaming. Off the heat, whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of salt until smooth, then whisk hard over low heat until frothy. Pour into 4 heavy mugs.

dishes.make_ahead: Boil, peel and wrap the eggs up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; crumb and fry on the night, or fry up to 1 day ahead and serve cold

steps.text: Lower 4 of the eggs into a pot of boiling water and cook for 7 minutes.
Lift into iced water, cool for 10 minutes, then peel.
Mix the sausage mince with the sage, mustard and pepper. Divide into 4, flatten each piece in your palm and wrap it around a peeled egg, sealing the seams.
Beat the last egg. Roll each wrapped egg in the flour, then the beaten egg, then the breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil in a deep heavy pot to 170C.
Fry 2 at a time for 6 to 7 minutes, turning, until deep golden and the sausage is cooked through. Drain, sprinkle with salt and cut in half to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Boil, peel and wrap the eggs up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; crumb and fry on the night

steps.text: Lower 4 of the eggs into a pot of boiling water and cook for 7 minutes.
Lift into iced water, cool for 10 minutes, then peel.
Mash the vegetarian sausage meat with the fresh breadcrumbs, sage, mustard and pepper until it holds together. Divide into 4 and wrap around the peeled eggs, sealing the seams.
Beat the last egg. Roll each wrapped egg in the flour, then the beaten egg, then the panko.
Heat the oil in a deep heavy pot to 170C.
Fry 2 at a time for 4 to 5 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain, sprinkle with salt and cut in half to serve.

dishes.make_ahead: Shape the cakes up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry just before serving

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and cut into even chunks.
Boil in salted water until tender, drain well and leave to steam dry.
Mash roughly, leaving some lumps.
Fry the onion and cabbage in half the butter until soft and catching at the edges.
Mix into the potato, season well with salt and pepper and shape into 8 small flat cakes. Dust with the flour.
Chill to firm up.
Fry in the oil and remaining butter over medium heat, 4 minutes a side, in batches, until crusted and golden.
Serve hot with the brown sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling and mash up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; assemble and bake on the night, adding 10 minutes

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and cut into chunks. Dice the onion, carrots and celery and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large heavy pan and brown the mince well, in batches.
Add the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and cook until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste and flour and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the stock, Worcestershire and thyme and simmer, partly covered, until thick. Meanwhile boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk. Season with salt and pepper. Heat the oven to 200C.
Stir the peas into the mince, season and tip into a baking dish. Spread the mash on top, rough it up with a fork and scatter with the cheddar.
Bake until bubbling and golden on top.
Rest before serving.

veg.n: Fury 161 lentil and mushroom cottage pie
veg.make_ahead: Make the filling and mash up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; assemble and bake on the night, adding 10 minutes

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and cut into chunks. Dice the onion, carrots and celery and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large heavy pan and fry the mushrooms hard until browned and dry.
Add the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and cook until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste and flour and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils, stock, soy sauce and thyme and simmer until thick. Meanwhile boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk. Season with salt and pepper. Heat the oven to 200C.
Stir the peas into the lentils, season and tip into a baking dish. Spread the mash on top, rough it up with a fork and scatter with the cheddar.
Bake until bubbling and golden on top.
Rest before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Assemble and soak up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; bake on the night, adding 5 minutes

steps.text: Butter a baking dish. Butter the bread on one side, trim the crusts if you like and cut into triangles.
Layer the bread in the dish, buttered side up, scattering the sultanas between the layers.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, caster sugar and vanilla and pour over the bread.
Leave to soak, pressing the bread down once or twice. Heat the oven to 170C.
Grate the nutmeg over and sprinkle with the demerara sugar.
Bake until puffed, just set in the middle and golden on top.
Rest before serving warm.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the chocolate base up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; reheat gently and whisk to a froth before serving

steps.text: Whisk the milk, cocoa, brown sugar, cinnamon and chilli in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming.
Take off the heat and whisk in the chocolate and salt until smooth.
Return to low heat and whisk hard until frothy.
Pour into 4 heavy mugs.
